newsitem.title: FRANCE: French ONIC open for grain bids despite strike.
newsitem.headline: French ONIC open for grain bids despite strike.

text.p: A one-day public sector strike in France will not affect the processing of European Union grain export bids at a weekly tender on Thursday, officials said.
The French cereals office ONIC, which handles the bulk of export bids sent to the EU each Thursday, is open as usual, they said.
"There is no problem," one ONIC official said.
The one-day strike against French austerity policies hit trains, flights, schools and public services.
